review_method: All 14 QA02 pages were read, then the source word by word, which produced ten replacements. All 14 QA03 pages were read again in full from the released PDF; each replacement was located on its page and the page breaks were compared with QA02.

page_notes.1: Title, eleven-line abstract, introduction with the deeper-deposit wording and condition equation legible; Section 2 starts on this page.
page_notes.2: Target, geometry, gun context, materials, geometry figure, graph and population opening legible.
page_notes.3: Population, generator overview, architecture diagram and response equation legible.
page_notes.4: Response cap, activity factorization, flow target, flow-matching loss and update rule legible.
page_notes.5: Channel counts, placement, sampler, share target and decoder legible.
page_notes.6: Training, checkpoint selection, evaluation definitions with the reworded edge sentence, gap count and component bound legible; page full.
page_notes.7: Bound caveats with the explicit subject, Wasserstein and reference-half definitions, classifier paragraph one line longer with the checkpoint named, Table 1 and deposited-energy opening legible.
page_notes.8: Figure 3 with the cancellation caption, response error scales quoting both largest binwise differences, empty showers and longitudinal activity legible; page ends on the same line as before.
page_notes.9: Figure 4, hit-pattern results, transverse paragraph naming the narrower sample, co-occupancy and classifier results legible.
page_notes.10: Closure residuals, discussion, limitations opening with the zero-threshold wording and timing opening legible.
page_notes.11: Detector applications, conclusion, availability, acknowledgments, disclosure and Appendix A opening legible.
page_notes.12: Calibration table, settings, test-exposure statement, Appendix B and energy-bin table legible; Table 3 rows match the two values now quoted in Sec. 5.1.
page_notes.13: Classifier-seed table, evaluator details and references 1-16 legible.

scope: Document consistency and visual review, not new physics validation.
